name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
storyline:
36 years before the events of Tavern Talk, the Wayfarer's Inn's future innkeeper meets their very own party for the first time, as it slowly comes together under the guidance of the Tavernkeeper of the Drowsy Dragon: You.
Host a cast of colorful adventurers in your tavern, send them on equally exciting, suspenseful and silly quests and help them develop friendships, rivalries and even romances, all while serving them your most delicious drinks. Maybe with your help, your patrons can uncover what's behind the strange events plaguing Phesoa, that threaten to turn dreams and nightmares into reality.
summary: Welcome Tavernkeep! In this D&D-inspired visual novel you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.
